title: Correct QCLI-305 record notes: test count and real-run evidence head
description: Two stale claims in the QCLI-305 record, found during its confirmatory check and filed by the quest-cli worker at team-lead instruction. The shipped work is correct; only the record text is wrong, so this is a note correction, not a behavior change. (1) The implementation note that describes the test file says it holds 7 tests; test/qcli305-install-platform-candidates.test.ts has 8 test() calls, because the round-2 fresh-inode test took it from 7 to 8 and that note was never updated. (2) The AC4 real-run evidence note names the extracted head 164d3565, which predates the final install code head 8d98cb3b (round 2: fresh-inode recreate and refuse-partial) and the later test-only fix 891dc318, so as written it can read as evidence for install code the run did not execute.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The QCLI-305 implementation note that says the test file holds 7 tests reads 8, consistent with counting the test() calls in test/qcli305-install-platform-candidates.test.ts on the final head.

The QCLI-305 AC4 real-run evidence note names the head the run actually used (164d3565) and records that the final install code head is 8d98cb3b (round 2) with a later test-only fix at 891dc318, so it no longer implies the real run covered the shipped install code.
